name: habit-smells
title: Review and maintenance read habit-hooks smells as a findings source
outcome: Review and maintenance reports carry a classified Mechanical smells section from habit-sensors, maintenance trends the pairs of smell and file against the previous report, and verify_bundle warns when the last scan is missing or stale.
done_when: shared/habit_smells.py writes habit-smells.json from habit-sensors and states an incomplete run or a missing tool
review and maintenance write the Mechanical smells section and name the tool and branch base
verify_bundle reports habit.smells as ok, stale, or nothing, and a test covers it
abort_if: the script needs a new dependency or vendors the habit-hooks sensors
review must read the sensors' rendered coaching text instead of the JSON findings

min_work.note: Decided in chat on 2026-10-08 (ADR-0038). The script shells out to the installed habit-sensors through its JSON surface, and tests use a stub on PATH.

epics.title: The scan: shared/habit_smells.py writes habit-smells.json, and verify_bundle reports habit.smells
Review mode: the Mechanical smells section in both reports, with classification rules
Maintenance mode: the pair diff against the previous report, and the command files
